title: Finiteness of the fibre product of two finite modules over a fibre product of rings
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the fibre product of two finite modules over a fibre product of rings is again finite, and the proof is a 23-line generation argument. It chooses generators of the two modules, lifts them to elements of the fibre product using the identifications of the two base changes with the outer modules, shows that the images of the second family of lifts generate the second module, and then verifies by an explicit computation that the two families together generate the fibre product: an arbitrary element is first corrected in the first component and the resulting difference is written in the ideal times the second module, whose coefficients are then lifted through the kernel of the surjection of rings. The generation claim and the correction step are the content, and both are displayed.
